title: Open-weight adaptation methods for School and AUM
purpose: Descriptive research reference; not runtime configuration, an executable recipe, or an approved integration design.
support_interpretation: not_integrated means this catalog does not supply a School trainer or executor. Reusable measurement concepts do not establish integration.
target_boundary: Neural methods require an explicitly bound open-weight learner; AUM records and symbolic operations are separate adaptation targets.
baseline_objective: Supervised fine-tuning predicts tokens in approved demonstrations. LoRA/QLoRA supplies an update mechanism rather than the learning objective.
evaluation_caution: Keep preference producers' and teachers' observable context explicit; exclude private verifier context and held-out answers from learner inputs and adaptation data.

phases.P1: Baseline supervised adaptation, verified-trace distillation and preferences; separately measured harness proposals.
phases.P2: Controlled comparisons once baseline execution is verified.
phases.P3: Research integrations with additional compute, evaluator and candidate-management dependencies.

baseline_reference.name: LoRA Without Regret
baseline_reference.relevance: Supports a carefully configured LoRA baseline in tested post-training regimes; not universal parity or a quantized-training guarantee.

methods.name: QLoRA
target: neural adapter over a frozen quantized base

upstream_sources.date_certainty: repository; publication date belongs to the paper

methods.applicability: Baseline mechanism for adapting an explicitly bound neural learner used by AUM.
methods.suggested_phase: P1 — supervised baseline after reproducible measurement.
methods.limits: Adapter size and 4-bit storage do not establish full training cost or task quality.

methods.name: DoRA, PiSSA and EVA
methods.maturity: Published methods with PEFT implementations; compatibility is method-specific.
methods.applicability: Controlled alternatives to the learner's LoRA adapter, not changes to AUM symbolic records.
methods.suggested_phase: P2 — one-method comparisons against a fixed baseline.
methods.limits: Initialization, quantization and serving compatibility differ; no universal ranking is established.

methods.name: LoRA-FA
methods.maturity: Research method with a PEFT optimizer implementation.
methods.applicability: Potential activation-memory improvement for a measured neural adaptation baseline.
methods.suggested_phase: P2 — when activation memory is an observed bottleneck.
methods.limits: Measure complete peak memory and wall time rather than relying on trainable parameter count.

methods.name: Q-GaLore
methods.maturity: Published research with an upstream implementation.

upstream_sources.date_certainty: repository; publication date belongs to the paper

methods.applicability: Research option if adapter capacity demonstrably limits an AUM-bound neural learner.
methods.suggested_phase: P3 — after establishing a reason to update base weights.
methods.limits: A model fitting into VRAM does not establish inexpensive or fast end-to-end training.

methods.name: Direct Preference Optimization
target: neural learner through adapter or full update
methods.maturity: Published method with established TRL support.
methods.applicability: Learn from independently justified preferences between comparable learner responses.
methods.suggested_phase: P1 — after trustworthy preference pairs are available.
methods.limits: Preference provenance and comparable context are required; preferred does not automatically mean correct.

methods.name: GRPO and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards

publication_date.note: GRPO introduction; DeepSeek-R1 is a 2025 exemplar.

methods.maturity: Published methods with active upstream trainer implementations.
methods.applicability: Train neural proposals using independently executable checks of bounded AUM tasks.
methods.suggested_phase: P2 — after frozen-policy and supervised baselines.
methods.limits: GRPO and RLVR are distinct; rollout cost, reward exploitation and verifier leakage require measurement.

methods.name: Verified-trace distillation

publication_date.note: DeepSeek-R1 exemplar; distillation itself predates QLoRA.

methods.applicability: Transfer checked teacher or search-produced behavior into a local neural learner using approved episodes.
methods.suggested_phase: P1 — reuse verified episodes before purchasing new generation.
methods.limits: Teacher outputs are not correctness evidence; teacher context and evaluation answers must not leak.

methods.name: TinyLoRA
target: neural adapter coefficients and fixed reconstruction structures
methods.maturity: Recent research with a PEFT implementation.
methods.applicability: Research comparison for very small RL updates to an already capable neural learner.
methods.suggested_phase: P2 — after a working GRPO baseline.
methods.limits: Reported learned bytes exclude the base model and fixed structures; evidence centers on math tasks.

methods.name: MiCA
target: neural base model through a constrained adapter
methods.maturity: Recent preprint with an upstream PEFT example.
methods.applicability: Controlled domain-knowledge ingestion experiment for a bound neural learner.
methods.suggested_phase: P2 — compare with retrieval-only and ordinary LoRA controls.
methods.limits: Limited evidence from 7B-scale models and controlled corpora; primarily continued pretraining.

methods.name: SEAL
target: generated training material and update directives

upstream_sources.note: Abstract/repository inspected; exact current paper revision not pinned.

methods.applicability: Later research on learner-generated adaptation proposals evaluated through School.
methods.suggested_phase: P3 — after an ordinary candidate lifecycle is verified.
methods.limits: Nested training is costly; generated directives are proposals, not evidence of improvement.

methods.name: TTT-Discover
methods.maturity: Recent research with public code and reported experiments.

upstream_sources.note: Primary abstract/project inspected; exact current paper revision not pinned.

methods.applicability: Later optimization study over a bounded AUM task with independently scored solutions.
methods.suggested_phase: P3 — compare against frozen-policy search at matched budget.
methods.limits: Single-problem solution quality is distinct from general capability; published setup uses a hosted 120B model.

methods.name: Harness and weights co-evolution

publication_date.note: Primary README says 2026 and still has an arXiv-link placeholder.

methods.maturity: Recent research implementation with released run records.

upstream_sources.note: Blob hash identifies inspected content, not a commit or executable recipe pin.

methods.applicability: Separate AUM/School harness changes from learner updates and measure their individual and joint contributions.
methods.suggested_phase: P1 for measurement concepts; P3 for complete research reproduction.
methods.limits: Published reproduction needs four 80GB GPUs and external services; teacher-free does not mean service-free.

methods.name: Direct self-rewriting of weights
methods.applicability: Exploratory neural-weight proposal research; distinct from changing AUM symbolic operations.
methods.suggested_phase: P3 — isolated research after candidate evaluation and rollback are proven.
methods.limits: Sessions restart from base weights; the reported sequence is not cumulative training initialized from each accepted update.
